title: Using Connectors
description: Explains when approved external information or systems are needed.

steps.title: View available Connectors
steps.description: Select the Connectors icon from the side menu to view all available Connectors.

steps.title: Open Connectors
steps.description: Select Connectors from the toolbar beneath the chat box.

steps.title: Choose an approved source
steps.description: Select the checkbox beside the Connector you want MyAssist to use. Choose only sources relevant to your task.

steps.title: Ask your question
steps.description: Write your request as normal and name the source you want MyAssist to use.

steps.title: Review the request
steps.description: Check that MyAssist used the selected Connector and that the response meets your needs.
